headline: Cristiano Ronaldo marries Georgina Rodriguez in private Portugal ceremony
summary: Football superstar Cristiano Ronaldo and his long-term partner Georgina Rodriguez have officially tied the knot in a private civil ceremony held in Cascais, Portugal.
details: Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez have officially married in a private civil ceremony in Portugal. The couple, together for a decade, exchanged vows on Tuesday, making their union official.
The news was shared via a joint Instagram post featuring their hands adorned with matching gold wedding rings, captioned "C <3 G". The announcement quickly garnered over a million likes.
The intimate ceremony took place in Cascais, a coastal town near Lisbon, with their five children reportedly in attendance. A representative confirmed the private nature of the event.
Their relationship began in 2016 after they met at a Gucci shop in Madrid where Georgina worked. They publicly confirmed their romance the following year.

Together, they have built a family including Georgina's two biological children, Alana Martina and Bella Esmeralda, and Ronaldo's eldest son, Cristiano Jr, and twins Mateo and Eva. The couple tragically lost their other twin, Angel, in 2022.
Ronaldo had proposed in 2025, but the wedding plans were kept private, aligning with Georgina's preference for intimate gatherings over large parties, as Ronaldo previously stated.

The 41-year-old five-time Ballon d’Or winner continues his career with Al-Nassr and recently confirmed the 2026 World Cup would be his last, having already made history by scoring in six different World Cup editions.
caption:
After a decade together, football icon Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez have finally tied the knot in a private ceremony in Portugal.

Cristiano Ronaldo and Georgina Rodriguez have officially married in a private civil ceremony in Portugal. The couple, together for a decade, exchanged vows on Tuesday, making their union official.

The news was shared via a joint Instagram post featuring their hands adorned with matching gold wedding rings, captioned "C <3 G". The announcement quickly garnered over a million likes.

The intimate ceremony took place in Cascais, a coastal town near Lisbon, with their five children reportedly in attendance. A representative confirmed the private nature of the event.

Their relationship began in 2016 after they met at a Gucci shop in Madrid where Georgina worked. They publicly confirmed their romance the following year.

Together, they have built a family including Georgina's two biological children, Alana Martina and Bella Esmeralda, and Ronaldo's eldest son, Cristiano Jr, and twins Mateo and Eva. The couple tragically lost their other twin, Angel, in 2022.

Ronaldo had proposed in 2025, but the wedding plans were kept private, aligning with Georgina's preference for intimate gatherings over large parties, as Ronaldo previously stated.

The 41-year-old five-time Ballon d’Or winner continues his career with Al-Nassr and recently confirmed the 2026 World Cup would be his last, having already made history by scoring in six different World Cup editions.

headline_marked: [[Bangladesh faces urgent energy crisis]], experts call for domestic focus, renewables, and reforms
headline: Bangladesh faces urgent energy crisis, experts call for domestic focus, renewables, and reforms
summary: Experts urge swift, multi-pronged action to tackle Bangladesh's worsening energy crisis, emphasizing reduced import dependence and accelerated domestic gas exploration.
details: Bangladesh requires urgent and coordinated action to address its escalating energy crisis, according to experts. They advocate for a stronger focus on domestic resources, renewable energy, and comprehensive energy-sector reforms.

The experts, speaking at a seminar by the Forum for Energy Reporters Bangladesh (FERB), stressed the need to reduce reliance on imported fuels. They also called for the development of neglected gas fields, improved energy efficiency, and increased private-sector investment under strict regulatory frameworks.

Former BUET dean Prof Ijaz Hossain highlighted the critical need to accelerate gas exploration to determine remaining potential and decrease dependence on imported LNG. Domestic gas production has significantly dropped to around 1,700 million cubic feet per day (MMcfd) from a peak of 2,786 MMcfd in 2017.

Prof Hossain warned that without faster exploration, Bangladesh's gas reserves, currently less than 8 trillion cubic feet (Tcf), could be nearly exhausted by 2030. He recommended rapid development of Bhola gas, deep offshore exploration, and revival of idle fields.

While LNG imports and additional terminals are necessary for the immediate crisis, they are not a long-term solution due to foreign currency requirements. Gas demand is projected to reach 4,600 MMcfd by 2030, necessitating substantial domestic production and LNG purchases.

Power and Energy Minister Iqbal Hassan Mahmood Tuku stated the government's aggressive move to expand rooftop solar, targeting 10,000 MW of generation. The government will encourage private investment in cluster-based rooftop solar projects with incentives like a five-year tax holiday.

The minister also noted plans to collaborate with Malaysia's Petronas on Bhola gas development and invite international companies for offshore exploration. He acknowledged that inadequate gas pressure is severely affecting businesses and increasing the risk of loan defaults.

The government plans to arrange a meeting involving the prime minister, industrialists, and experts to discuss the industrial crisis. State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Anindya Islam Amit also apologized to the public for the ongoing energy challenges.
